entries.title: A card's choices read as one line of words again
entries.body: When a choice on a card named a task or carried the Recommended tag, its words could split into narrow side-by-side columns. Each choice now reads as one paragraph, its task links and tags in line with the words, and a long choice wraps under its first word.

picture.alt: A decision card with three choices, each a bold lead and its words on one or two lines, a task link and a Recommended tag in line
